messages:
nora.docs: opened a PR to correct the API reference for /v1/generate. the OpenAPI examples and the generated Ruby snippet are out of sync: site shows `input: string` and `model`, but the API and our runtime expect `inputs: string[]` and `model_id`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987

diego.eng: can you paste the current (broken) curl on the site and the corrected example so i can run a quick smoke test on staging?

nora.docs: broken (published):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "redwood/gpt-3x", "input": "Short summary please"}'
```
fixed (canonical HTTP shape + matches SDK):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/gpt-3x", "inputs": ["Short summary please"], "max_new_tokens": 40}'
```

sam.sdk: noted. the Ruby client generator pulls examples from the OpenAPI examples; we ended up shipping a generated snippet using `input:` and positional strings which confuses customers. i'll change the generator template to prefer array examples and open sdk PR 990 to publish a hand-edited snippet showing `inputs: ["..."]` and a one-line compat note.

anya.prod: please add a short migration callout at the top of the endpoint page: "If you previously passed `input` (string), switch to `inputs` (array). `model` has been renamed to `model_id`. SDKs accept legacy keys for now but docs show canonical names." CS and release notes need that.

lighthouse-bot: docs/link-check: failed in docs/pull/1987 — broken anchor to /sdk/ruby#generate-example.

diego.eng: ran the corrected curl against staging — 200 OK. sample response i pasted into the PR as the approved response example:
```json
{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","choices":[{"text":"TL;DR: concise summary."}],"request_id":"req_zz999"}
```

nora.docs: i'll update the OpenAPI request/response examples to use `inputs: string[]` and `choices` response with `text` field. also adding the migration note and a brief Ruby snippet that shows both canonical and legacy forms so customers can follow along.

sam.sdk: on the SDK side i'll add the explicit Ruby example: `client.generate(model_id: 'redwood/gpt-3x', inputs: ['...'])` and a compatibility note: "Ruby SDK accepts `input:` for now but prefer `inputs:` going forward." will coordinate to land sdk PR 990 after the docs link fix.

nora.docs: who can merge once the link-check is green? prefer to ship before next docs-publish window.

diego.eng: i can merge after one final smoke test and green link-check. ping here once lighthouse-bot is happy. :thumbsup:

nora.docs: thanks everyone — tracking: docs PR 1987 (OpenAPI examples + migration note), sdk PR 990 (Ruby snippet + generator template), follow-up release note blurb.
